Assignment ke liye research karni hai? 🔍

Perplexity mein bas apna sawaal normal language mein type karo. Answer aane ke baad source khud open karke zaroor check karo.

Aap research ke liye kya use karte ho? Comment mein batao 👇

Save karo, follow karo @promptpandit.in

Source: perplexity.ai (official site)

#perplexity #aitools #studytips #research #aiforstudents #promptpandit

Padha, par yaad nahi? 📚

Is prompt se kisi bhi chapter ke short revision notes, key terms aur 5 MCQs ek saath banao. Answers end mein, taaki pehle khud try karo.

Kaunsa subject sabse tough lagta hai? 👇

Save karo, follow karo @promptpandit.in

#studytips #revision #aiforstudents #promptengineering #examprep #promptpandit

'Tell me about yourself' pe atak jaate ho? 🎤

Galat: AI ko bina details ke bolna.
Sahi: role, degree, ek project aur 2 skills do, phir 60-second answer maango.

Answer milne ke baad usse apne words mein practice karo. Aapka target role kya hai? 👇

Save karo, follow karo @promptpandit.in

#interviewtips #jobsearch #freshers #promptengineering #careeradvice #promptpandit

Ek AI tutor jo seedha answer nahi deta 🤔

Khanmigo, Khan Academy ka AI tutor, aapko khud sochne aur problem solve karne mein guide karta hai. Algebra, SQL ya essay writing, sab mein.

Availability aur price site pe zaroor check karo. Aapko hints pasand hain ya direct answers? 👇

Save karo, follow karo @promptpandit.in

Source: khanmigo.ai (official site)

#khanmigo #khanacademy #aitools #aiforstudents #studytips #promptpandit

Koi topic samajh nahi aa raha? 🧠

3-step prompt:
1. Explain like I'm a beginner
2. Give one real-life example from India
3. Ask me 3 questions to check if I understood

Kaunsa topic try karoge? 👇

Save karo, follow karo @promptpandit.in

#studytips #promptengineering #aiforstudents #learning #chatgptprompts #promptpandit

Aapki LinkedIn headline kya kehti hai? 💼

'Student at XYZ College' se kaam nahi chalega. Role + skills + kya dhoondh rahe ho, ye likho. Aur prompt last slide se pehle hai, copy karo.

Apni headline comment mein daalo, feedback denge 👇

Save karo, follow karo @promptpandit.in

#linkedin #linkedintips #freshers #jobsearch #personalbranding #promptpandit

Notes ko diagram mein badalna hai? 📊

Napkin AI mein text paste karo, click karo, aur suggested visuals mein se choose karo. Edit karke PPT, PNG, PDF ya SVG mein export karo.

Project presentation ke liye kaam aayega? 👇

Save karo, follow karo @promptpandit.in

Source: napkin.ai (official site)

Exam date se ulta plan banao 📅

Pehle revision aur mock-test days fix karo, phir baaki topics fill karo. Prompt copy karo aur apni details daalo.

Aapka exam kab hai? 👇

Save karo, follow karo @promptpandit.in

#studyplan #examprep #studytips #aiforstudents #promptengineering #promptpandit

Job application email: Galat vs Sahi ✉️

Role, company, degree aur skills do, aur short, polite email maango. Bhejne se pehle ek baar khud padh lo.

Kis role ke liye apply kar rahe ho? 👇

Save karo, follow karo @promptpandit.in

#jobsearch #jobapplication #emailwriting #freshers #promptengineering #promptpandit

Apne notes se AI tutor banao 📒

Gemini Notebook (notebooklm.google) mein apne sources add karo aur sawaal pucho. Answers aapke diye material pe based hote hain. Audio Overviews, flashcards aur quizzes bhi.

Answers hamesha apni book se match karo. Try kiya hai? 👇

Save karo, follow karo @promptpandit.in

Source: notebooklm.google (official site)

#notebooklm #gemini #aitools #studytips #aiforstudents #promptpandit

Interview se darr lagta hai? 😅

AI ko interviewer banao: ek time pe ek sawaal, aur har answer ke baad feedback + better version. Answers zor se bolo, phir type karo.

Aapka next interview kis role ke liye hai? 👇

Save karo, follow karo @promptpandit.in

#interviewtips #mockinterview #freshers #jobsearch #promptengineering #promptpandit

Code mein error? AI se aise pucho 💻

Galat: 'Fix it.'
Sahi: error + code + expected output do, aur pehle cause samjhane ko bolo.

Aur haan: passwords ya API keys kabhi paste mat karo. Aap kaunsi language seekh rahe ho? 👇

Save karo, follow karo @promptpandit.in
